nom: Youth To The People Superfood Cleanser - Kale + Spinach Hydrating Face Wash

segments.oily: One reviewer with combined-to-oily skin calls it her go-to cleanser, and another who struggled to find a balance between dry and oily skin says this cleanser leaves her face feeling clear.
segments.dry: Reports are mixed for dry skin: several reviewers say it doesn't dry out their skin, but at least three, including one with dry, rosacea-prone skin, report it left their face feeling dry or tight, especially without a moisturizer afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it cleans without stripping or drying their skin.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with perioral dermatitis, report a gentle, non-irritating wash that controls occasional breakouts, but one reviewer with sensitive, rosacea-prone skin says it dried her face out badly and doesn't recommend it for dry sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: Reports are split: many reviewers say it cleans without drying their skin, including some who follow up with a moisturizer, but others, including one with rosacea and dry sensitive skin, report it dried their face out badly, and a couple say it's not ideal for extremely dry skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her skin looked clearer and less red after about a week of use.
concerns.blemishes: Evidence is limited: one reviewer with sensitive skin says it helps control occasional breakouts and small bumps, while another with sensitive, breakout-prone skin says it didn't cause new breakouts but couldn't say whether it prevented them.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer who struggled to find a cleanser that didn't leave her skin too dry or too oily reports this one leaves her face feeling clear and balanced.

aspects.libelle: Thick gel that lathers easily; a little goes a long way
Glass, refillable packaging seen as eco-friendly
Frequent pump and packaging defects: leaking, broken or cracked
Considered expensive for the price, especially versus buying direct
May not fully remove heavier or waterproof makeup

extraits.titre: Dawn dish soap for your face
extraits.texte: So I've had this for about mmmmm 3-4 months now? And don't get me wrong it smells A-MAZING! (My 4 year old daughter is obsessed with it) smells like everything I SHOULD be eating in a salad lol; but dude this is like put dawn dish soap on my face. Maybe this is good for people who have oily skin? That can really scrub a dub dub there face? But I have sensitive rosacea skin (white girl problems) so when I was using this, I had to legit rub, lather, rub and repeat just to get the layer of soap to "render" down(with water), and THEN came the suds. I legit was washing my face for like 5-10 min with this soap! Ooph it dried my face out like crazy. Thankfully I follow the ten ste Korean skin care regime or jeez my face would be SO DRY. So honestly I only use this after I put a clay face mask off because I know it will get everything off, but I definitely don't recommend it for dry sensitive skin. Btw I'm half American/half Salvadoran with primarily European roots (Spain, England ect.) so i don't have a lot of breakouts, in fact I have the opposite of dry sensitive skin (rosacea, karatosis pilaris) 😩 wouldn't recommend it for dry sensitive skin.

This isn’t the worst cleanser in the world, but there’s definitely better out there. It isn’t worth the price, I don’t look glowy, fresh or brighter after, and it really dries my skin out. I would skip this one. The bottle is pretty cute though.

extraits.titre: A good, clean face wash for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: The cleanser overall seems to work well. The gel is thick when it comes out of the pump, but lathers up VERY easily - so a little goes a long way. The smell is a nice "clean" smell. It's not super strong or overpowering, which I personally love. It also seems to cleanse the makeup off my face well. I have very sensitive skin and I was hoping it would help more with hormonal breakouts. I can't say that it say caused any breakouts, but I can't speak to whether or not it helps to prevent breakouts. I think this face wash is great for probably all skin types!

I received a trial size of the super food cleanser and fell in love after the first use. My skin feels super clean and not dried out afterwards. After a week of use, my skin looks clearer and redness has reduced. The product is lightly scented, but not offensive. It is pricey, but a little goes a long way. I pair it with the air whip moisture cream. My only complaint is the packaging. There is no seal on the bottle when you take the cap off. I received my order with a crack in the cap and there was some product leakage. It does arrive with a pump to use.

extraits.titre: Perfection! Coming from someone with super sensitive skin!Perfection! Coming from someone with super sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I have super sensitive skin and for years as someone who does love skin care and all, this is one out of only three brands that’s actually work for me! It’s so gentle in my skin and helps a lot to control any breakouts if they ever come up, even if it’s just a pimple or two, it’s super good at cleansing and gentle and in general just fantastic for anyone with sensitive skin! It’s worth the money and I genuinely recommend it! I first tried it with a sample birthday box thing from sephora and it was the small size and ever since then I’ve been wanting to get my hands back on this and finally bought it, really really love this. I have been using this again for a good bit now and my skin feels smoother and even small bumps that come up literally have gone away! It’s worth the love and hype 100%!!!

extraits.titre: Gentle for my combined skin type
extraits.texte: I like that doesn’t stripping dry my face and not too foamy, my face feel fresh and clean after using this, definitely recommend

I have a combined to oily skin and has been looking forever for a good face wash and this one is to die for! You get an 8 oz bottle (which is really big), so its a really good value. The product is good for all types of skin and 1 to 2 pumps is enough for a wash (which is so little!!)
